evidence: Devils Punchbowl Walking Track is signposted from Devils Punchbowl Falls car park.
The track then climbs steeply up through native mountain beech/tāwhairauriki forest to a viewing platform near the base of the waterfall.
Return to the car park the same way you came.

doubts: Start ref F2 is the only feature where this track meets a road (named on the map 'Otira Railway Tunnel'); text names only the car park off SH73. End is a viewing platform, not the waterfall itself, so ref null. Wardens Creek is placed before the Bealey River bridge per the hazards note.
